modelName: Solar panels detection with post-processing focused on ground-mounted panels
organisation: Estonian Land and Spatial Development Board
inputSpecification: RGB 3 band raster 10-20cm GSD. Best input - Estonian orthoimagery starting from 2025 with 10cm GSD.
outputSpecification: 1 band raster with 2 classes: solar panel and other. \nAfter post-processing output is: geopackage with polygons of ground-mounted solar parks. Number of panels in solar park is included as attribute.
moreInformation: In combination with existing Estonian Topographic Database and post-processing the precision of new solar parks detected is ~80-90% (from 600 \"potential solar park\" polygons ~500-570 will be real ones)
